series_overall_design: 8-14 week old ILC2 reporter mice were used to sort steady-state activated ILC2 from bone marrow, lung, visceral adipose tissue, small intestine lamina propia and skin.

!Sample_treatment_protocol_ch1: Il5(Red5), Arg1(Yarg), and Il13(Smart13) reporter alleles on wild-type C57BL/6 background were used to prepare single cell suspensions from bone marrow (BM), lung, adipose tissue (fat), and small intestinal lamina propria (gut) as previously described (von Moltke J et al, Nature 2016; Van Dyken SJ et al, Immunity 2014; Molofsky AB et al, J. Exp Med 2013). For skin single cell suspensions, pooled ear/back or back tissue was minced in RPMI-1640 with 10% FBS, then transferred to C tubes (Miltenyi Biotec), containing 5ml of RPMI-1640 supplemented with Collagenase XI (2mg/ml; Sigma C9407), Hyaluronidase (0.5mg/ml; Sigma H3506), and DNAse I (0.1mg/ml; Sigma 10104159001).  Samples were shaken at 200-250 rpm for 90min at 37¡ C, then dispersed using an automated tissue dissociator (GentleMACS; Miltenyi Biotec) running program C.  Single-cell suspensions were passed through a 70um filter and washed twice with RPMI containing 10% FBS. Cells were sorted as Lin-CD45+Red5+ for Lung, Gut, Skin and Fat. For BM, ILC2s were sorted as Lin-CD45+Yarg+.
!Sample_extract_protocol_ch1: We use the ChromiumTM Single Cell 3 Reagent Kits v2 per the manufacturer instructions.
!Sample_data_processing: 10x data for scRNA samples are run through cellranger software to produce the fastqfiles.
The fastq files are processed throgh the cellranger count to get differential expression counts.
Genome_build: The data is aligned to mm10 genome
Supplementary_files_format_and_content: The processed data files are cellranger count matrix files.
